title: W11296289 — ATHENA service mode entry
description: Enter ATHENA auto service mode (7 steps + fail display).

steps.title: Enter ATHENA service mode
steps.body: Within 30 s of power-up, set TEMP to minimum. Hold door switch closed and press RC TEMP 5 s. Advance with SW1 — wait 3 s between presses. Step 6 shows fail LED pattern if fault stored.
